citation: Jiaqi, Zihan, Wong H-S, et al. J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2024;21:2334680
protocol: Cycle ergometer HIIE: warm-up, 8 x 1 min at 85% of peak power output (PPO 123 +/- 25 W) with 1 min at 20% PPO between, cool-down, 2.5 h after nitrate-depleted placebo juice (the 0 mmol arm is the one to read); HR, BP, glucose, lactate at stated points of the session
population: 13 healthy recreationally active women, 22.9 +/- 1.8 y, BMI 21.1 +/- 1.9
note: Placebo arm of a beetroot-juice crossover; HR given at every work and recovery interval; glucose and lactate at baseline and exhaustion in Table 1 (preliminary test) and across the session in Table 2. Read only the placebo column. Slug from the family name Zhang; the XML swaps given and family names.
